items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: I followed a band that was playing in there named Mark Fisher

ctx.x: Obviously. Well, one thing -- we started off this tape -- we were gonna talk about Danny Thomas and somehow we never talked about Danny Thomas. You were going to tell me --
Oh yes. This was at the 5100 Club in Chicago when I had that big band, and I followed a band that was playing in there named Mark Fisher -- does the name ring a bell?
